An AppImage is the app itself rather than an installer, so deleting it leaves nothing to come back to. Signing in opens your browser, and the browser hands you back to Gryt — which it cannot do from here.

Gryt can move itself to {{appsDir}} and carry on.

nativeFull.moveFailedDetail: Move {{trashedAt}} to {{appsDir}} yourself, then start Gryt from there. Sign-in will work once it is running from a permanent home.
nativeFull.locationChangedDetail:
It was launched from {{path}}, which is no longer there. An AppImage is the app itself rather than an installer, so moving or deleting it breaks the link your browser uses to hand sign-in back.

Put the AppImage somewhere permanent — {{appsDir}} is a good home — and start Gryt from there.

updates.description: Check for updates and see your current version.

profile.description: Your display name, avatar and identity.

edit_my_card.description: The card people see when they hover your name: its colour or gradient, pattern and pattern tuning, built-in styles, Surprise me, card links, bio, pronouns and status line.

pronouns.description: Shown under your name on your card.

bio.description: A line or two about you on your card.

status_line.description: Shown on your card when you aren't playing anything.

banner.description: A picture across the top of your card, on servers that let you upload one.

security.description: Your recovery key and account passkeys.

privacy.description: Who can send you messages and who can call you.

who_can_send_me_messages.description: Anyone on the server, friends, or nobody. One answer for every server, and each server can have its own.

who_can_call_me.description: Anyone who can message you, friends, or nobody. Until you add a friend on a server, people you've written to there count.

message_history_on_this_device.description: Where your encrypted DM history is kept, and clearing it when it won't open.

your_devices.description: Each app or browser you use for encrypted DMs, on each server. Remove one you don't use anymore.

message_key_warnings.description: Warn when a server holds a message key this device didn't publish. Turn it off if your direct messages don't need to be private from the server.

persist_server_access_tokens.description: Keep server sign-in tokens between app sessions, or clear them when 唠蒯云 closes.

server_identities.description: Servers 唠蒯云 recognises by their identity key, and any it has blocked for answering with a different one. Unblock a server you rebuilt yourself.

my_servers.description: Servers 唠蒯云 runs on this machine. Start them, stop them, read their logs, and choose whether they start with the app.

center_my_face_automatically.description: Works out where your face is so everyone else's crop of your camera follows you instead of cutting you off. Detection runs on your machine; only two numbers are sent, never video.

theme.description: Pick one, or open the editor and change it while you use the app. A theme is a couple of dozen hex values, so a link is the whole thing.

the_server_we_run.description: 唠蒯云 runs one server itself, and the dialog for adding a server offers it when you have nothing to paste. Turning this off hides that row for good on this device, and turning it back on is what this is for.

typefaces_from_google.description: A theme can name any typeface. Letting 唠蒯云 fetch the ones you do not already have means Google sees your address and that you are running 唠蒯云. Off, a theme that names one falls back to a face you have.

ui_scale.description: How large 唠蒯云 draws everything. Ctrl+Plus and Ctrl+Minus do the same, and Ctrl+0 puts it back to 100%.

chat_font_size.description: The size messages are set in, with a preview underneath.

standalone_emoji_size.description: How big an emoji is drawn when a message is nothing but emoji.

tile_layout.description: How the voice grid arranges people once it is maximised or fullscreen. Match Google Meet allows tall narrow tiles and more columns; Biggest tiles picks whichever arrangement makes them largest.

two_people.description: What a channel with exactly two people in it looks like. One large and one small puts the other person in the panel and you in the corner; same size gives you both the same tile, stacked in the sidebar and side by side once there is room.

smiley_conversion.description: Turns typed smileys into emoji as you write them.

hotkeys.description: Keyboard and mouse-button shortcuts, including your push-to-talk key.

push_to_talk_key.description: Hold this key or mouse button to transmit your microphone. Only shown while input mode is push to talk.

desktop_notifications.description: Show a notification when a message arrives somewhere you are not looking. Never plays its own sound — the message sound does that.

warn_me_when_my_microphone_goes_silent.description: Says so if your microphone stops sending anything at all while you are in a voice channel. Some headsets mute their own noise floor between sentences, which looks the same from here.

fake_participants.description: Invents people in the voice channel you are in and in the member list around it, so both can be seen at counts a single account cannot reach. They render through the real voice view and the real member list, so this proves layout and nothing about the socket path.

in_the_voice_channel_with_you.description: How many invented people to put in the channel, on top of anyone actually there.

in_the_server_not_in_voice.description: How many more to put in the member list, spread across online, AFK and offline.

fake_chat.description: Posts messages from the invented people into the channel you are looking at — mentions, custom emoji, links with previews, code blocks, replies and a wall of text. Delivered through the same handler a real message arrives on. Nothing is sent to the server.

a_message_every.description: How often a fake message arrives, in seconds, while it is running.

addons.description: Extensions that add features to 唠蒯云.

squad_keys.description: Keys used by Squad voice chat.

pureVoice.speaker: Speaker
pureVoice.privateUpdateInfo: This custom build has no automatic update service. Install a new custom package after reviewing its release notes.
pureVoice.privateUpdateSafety: Keep the matching source and build materials supplied with each release. Continue using the same administrator profile when upgrading.
pureVoice.autoGateDescription: Learns background noise during eligible non-speech frames. The gate opening is separate from actual transmitted speech activity. Turn off for the manual threshold.
pureVoice.autoGateWaiting: Awaiting a live microphone, running processor and fresh frames
pureVoice.autoGateLearning: Learning background noise; no calibrated threshold yet
pureVoice.autoGateOpen: Gate open (does not prove remote delivery)
pureVoice.autoGateThresholdNote: This processed model input differs from the input meter before noise reduction. Moderate speech probability requires a learned floor, +10 dB to open / +6 dB to hold, and consecutive frames; probability ≥95% can open directly. Hangover can keep the gate open, so these are reference thresholds rather than one volume switch.
pureVoice.peerCuesDescription: Short rising and falling tones, only for other people in your current voice room.
pureVoice.peerCuesScope: Respects the join/leave sound switches below. Reconnect snapshots never make a sound.
pureVoice.peerCuesDndDescription: Silences room event sounds and their previews.
pureVoice.peerCueVolume: Independent from voice leveling and the receive volume slider. Deafen or receive volume zero silences cues; microphone mute does not.
pureVoice.qualityBoundary: This member’s own connection to the SFU; not peer-to-peer latency. Reports expire after 8 seconds.
pureVoice.priorDescription: Keeps level statistics on this device, isolated by account, server and member. No audio is saved or uploaded. Expires after 30 days; up to 500 records. Restoring history does not count as fresh speech.
pureVoice.movePending: Waiting for the server to confirm the move…
pureVoice.moveRecovery: The move was committed, but destination audio failed. Open {{host}} and select the destination voice channel again to recover. Your mute settings are preserved.
pureVoice.moveRecoveryPending: Destination audio is waiting for policy confirmation and remains blocked.
pureVoice.movePromotionPending: The move was committed. Destination policy is being checked; this client has not confirmed the destination connection yet.
pureVoice.speakDenied: You do not have permission to speak in this channel.
pureVoice.localMediaBoundary: This client sends and receives microphone audio only. Media allowed for other clients depends on server policy.
pureVoice.serverFeaturesBoundary: Moving members between channels and shared connection details require a compatible server. Unsupported actions remain unavailable; missing measurements show as unknown.

transport.title: Voice bandwidth
transport.description: The standard profile saves server bandwidth for group speech: 16 kbps / 60 ms via the server and 64 kbps / 20 ms on admitted peer paths. Server audio prioritizes speech intelligibility; actual traffic depends on negotiation, packetization and channel limits.
transport.shared: Standard: economical server audio / high-quality peer audio
transport.reconnect: Changes apply after reconnecting. Legacy esports mode does not override this voice bandwidth selection.
transport.bitrateDescription: The channel may impose a lower cap. This is RTP audio payload, excluding packet and network overhead.
transport.packetTimeDescription: The server must negotiate this preference. Longer packets add buffering delay.
transport.dtxDescription: Request fewer packets during silence. This setting alone does not prove the encoder reduces packet rate.
transport.fecDescription: Request packet-loss protection when supported. Negotiation alone does not prove redundancy is being sent.
transport.configurationBoundary: Configuration confirmation does not prove RTP savings or FEC recovery.

memberLan.addressAssignmentBoundary: The server assigned this address; device connectivity and game port reachability are unconfirmed.
memberLan.multipleDeviceAddresses: This account has multiple devices. Each IP belongs to one device; use the address of the device running the game.
memberLan.boundary: Community LAN membership is independent of voice rooms. Only authenticated user-to-peer bindings and fresh measurements are shown.
memberLan.voiceBoundary: Community LAN and voice media paths are independent; view another member's connection details to see this device's voice relationship with them.

reasons.missing: No authoritative media record for this direction
reasons.invalid: Media evidence is not yet verified
reasons.inconsistent: SDK selection and media availability disagree; awaiting SDK confirmation
reasons.media-unavailable: Stable usable media is not confirmed
reasons.underlay-unproven: Usable peer media selected; complete underlay path unconfirmed

nextHop.server: Known next hop: a server; the next hop does not prove the complete path

metrics.measured: Only measured metrics for the current selected media transport

connectionDetails.title: Connection details · {{nickname}}
connectionDetails.description: Read-only current observations. Missing or expired data is shown explicitly.
connectionDetails.transportBoundary: EasyTier direct or relay is a local route observation for the selected ICE pair. It does not prove member binding or the complete physical path.
connectionDetails.notReported: Not reported by the current provider
connectionDetails.sendNotReported: No authenticated receive receipt from this member
connectionDetails.selfBoundary: Your own row shows only local community LAN state and evidence age; view another member to see the send/receive voice relationship.
connectionDetails.sendBoundary: Selected send media requires an authenticated receipt from this member. Local outbound bytes or SFU RTCP do not prove that they received audio.
connectionDetails.metricBoundary: RTT belongs to the selected peer transport or local-to-SFU transport, not an end-to-end listening delay. Loss belongs to the exact selected audio track. Rates, cumulative bytes and history are not supplied by this provider.
